Given your conditions and following your care team's guidance, you should aim for at least 1.12 grams of protein per kilogram of body weight daily to support your health. Since you weigh 67 kg, this means about 75 grams of protein a day.

Make sure the majority comes from high biological value sources like lean meats (excluding fish and chicken due to allergies), dairy products (if tolerated), or plant-based options such as soy.

How do you currently plan your meals to meet these protein needs?
